title: A learned RNA score associates with survival in archived bladder-cancer data
summary: A ten-RNA LASSO score separated overall-survival groups in archived bladder-cancer data. The internal validation subset reported one-, two- and three-year AUCs of 0.663, 0.624 and 0.630. This is a retrospective association with outcome-informed screening, not a verified immunotherapy-response test.

source_review.scope: Primary computational Methods on score construction and cohort data; Results on TCGA survival; no experimental protocol review

evidence.tested: The TCGA analysis split 406 cases into 204 training and 202 validation records after prognostic screening; cohort-specific median scores defined high and low groups.
evidence.unknown: Outcome screening preceded the split, so the validation subset is not untouched. The separate 65-case local series is stated as collected in 2022–2023 yet reports three-year AUCs in a May 2024 article; that timeline is unresolved and its performance is excluded here. Cohort counts vary between 412 and 406. Treatment-response proxies, drug predictions and proposed molecular mechanisms are not validated clinical outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO fitted the ten-RNA survival signature after univariate outcome screening, enabling the represented score-to-recorded-survival comparison.
